description: This PHP file defines a data transfer object (DTO) class 'PerformanceTrackerLogSearchFilterParams' used for filtering search parameters related to performance tracker logs in the OrangeHRM HRM system. It includes property definitions, constructor initialization for default sorting, and getter/setter methods for the tracker ID filter.

classes.name: PerformanceTrackerLogSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for specifying search filters applied to performance tracker logs, including sorting options and tracker identification.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object with default sorting field and order.

methods.name: getTrackerId
methods.description: Returns the tracker ID filter value.

methods.name: setTrackerId
methods.description: Sets the tracker ID filter value.
